metadata.title: S&P 500 Executive Compensation Data
metadata.description: Executive compensation data for S&P 500 companies. 498 companies enriched with full NEO data from SEC EDGAR DEF 14A proxy filings. Primary fiscal year 2024 aligned — top-level CEO pay reflects FY2024 for consistency. 6164 NEO records, 100% title coverage. Team totals aligned to FY2024 to match CEO primary fiscal year (fixes prior mismatch where FY2025 NEO sum < FY2024 CEO for AXON/SBUX/SOLV/etc).
sources: AFL-CIO Executive Paywatch 2025 (CEO totals, median pay, pay ratios)
notes: Total compensation from Summary Compensation Table in proxy statements
Includes salary, bonus, stock awards, option awards, non-equity incentive, and other compensation
Stock awards valued at grant date fair value, not realized value
Pay ratios from company proxy statements per SEC Regulation S-K Item 402(u)
Some companies (e.g., Amazon) have low SCT totals because equity grants span multiple years
Tesla/Elon Musk has $0 compensation - correct per proxy filing
Some entries are FY2025 (ADSK, BBY, CRM, TJX, WDAY, NVDA, KMX) due to non-calendar fiscal years

Data quality flags: verified = component sum matches stated total; recomputed = stated total replaced with component sum; incomplete_components = equity data not parsed, total from filing; bloated_component = one component appears inflated, total from filing retained
WELL (Welltower) FY2025 $821M verified against DEF 14A — Shankh Mitra received $813.2M front-loaded multi-year equity grant
Compensation Governance Score: composite 0-100 from SoP approval, CEO concentration (inverted), pay ratio (inverted), and team completeness

BX (Blackstone) and KKR are partnerships/alternative asset managers — no standard SCT. EDGAR filing verified, compensation comes from carried interest/distributions, not traditional salary/equity packages. AFL-CIO totals used.
